problem_title: How can I get 'Recent Items' object Ids in Apex (soql) is it possible
caption:
How can I get 'Recent Items' object Ids in Apex (soql) is it possible

🔴 The Problem: 'Recent Items' pane shows recently viewed records for the selected tab. The list is derived from your recent items and includes records owned by you and other users. Is there any way to get this in apex?

✅ The Fix: There is a new object available in Summer '13 called RecentlyViewed that you can use in SOQL to get a user's recently viewed records.
